title: services: a declared 5xx from the service-storage, service-settings and service-i18n route handlers ships the underlying error's message text, where the platform withholds 5xx message text
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a named landing**. `reach:` exception: security, because a 5xx body may carry internal detail of the server. Measured once at route level on `service-storage`'s raw-byte routes by the #23143 dev (report on #23143, PR #23172). ⛔ The reproduction is held off public surfaces under the `domain:services` lane's disclosure rule; this card stays at function level. Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 (#21118) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE`. ⛔ Not a claim; grade and lane are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades it. The fix lands in three `domain:services` files, so the `domain:services` seat claims it next.

## What happens

Several route handlers in `packages/services/*` answer a declared 5xx with their own `sendError(res, 5xx, CODE, err?.message ?? 'FALLBACK')`. The underlying error's message text therefore reaches the caller. For some adapter or driver errors that text names server-side internals.

## Governing text

- `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`: "[#5437] A declared 5xx never ships its own message text." The REST layer withholds it and logs the original ("5xx message withheld from client").
- `packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts` (#8086): "…and a leaky 5xx message is withheld".
- These services send through their own `sendError` helpers and never reach that filter.

## Sites (single-line census on `origin/main` `e540e7ffb`)

The census matches `sendError` calls with a 5xx status whose message argument is `err.message` / `error.message`, excluding tests:

| File | Sites |
|---|---|
| `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts` | 8 |
| `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-routes.ts` | 5 |
| `packages/services/service-i18n/src/i18n-service-plugin.ts` | 3 |

Control: the rule's own site, `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`, is present (1 hit). The single-line pattern cannot see multi-line calls. The storage raw-byte handlers' arm is one such multi-line site, and PR #23172 already withholds it, in code it touched. The fixing dev re-runs the census with a multi-line scanner and a positive control.

## Acceptance

- Every 5xx these handlers declare answers with the route's generic message, never the error's own text. The original error keeps reaching the server log the way each family logs today. Prefer the REST layer's existing withholding helper if it can be reused; ⛔ no fourth copy of the rule.
- One pin per family: an injected fault whose message carries a recognisable string answers its declared 5xx, and the body contains none of that string. Each pin asserts `code` and `status`.
- 4xx answers are untouched. A caller-facing 4xx message is an answer by design (#8086's scope).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included:
- `5xx error response passes raw error message text to client storage settings i18n routes withhold message`: 6 hits. They are #23143 (the token-status card this came from), #22764 (closed; the REST write routes), #17411 (closed; raw Hono mounts' envelope), #5423 (closed; the REST 4xx pass-through), #3675 (closed; the i18n envelope shape) and #3398 (closed). None is these handlers' 5xx text.
- `5xx message withheld leaky internal error message sendError INTERNAL err.message`: 2 hits. They are #5437 (closed; the REST layer's own `sendError`, which this card's rule comes from) and #7739 (closed). Neither covers these services' own helpers.
